scenarios.scenario_abstract: For travel spanning tropical humidity, snow, desert heat, and monsoon rain, [X] plans a two-pair rotation and assigns each pair a role based on ventilation, insulation, drying after getting wet, grip, and luggage bulk, without assuming that either pair is already owned.
examples: testing both pairs on wet pavement
wearing the bulkier pair in transit
recording which construction dries overnight
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为跨越热带湿气、冰雪、沙漠高温和季风降雨的旅行准备鞋履时，[X]会规划两双鞋的轮换，并根据通风、保暖、湿后干燥、抓地和行李体积来分配用途，同时不预设已经拥有其中任何一双。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before putting bicarbonate paste on familiar white sneakers, [X] identifies the upper, sole, finish, and glued seams, tests a hidden patch, and adjusts scrubbing, moisture, and drying after noticing that a treatment safe on one component may dry, abrade, stain, or loosen another.
examples: using a light paste and gentle brush on Canvas, Textile, Rubber, or a wipe-clean Synthetic/Plastic panel
spot-testing Leather or Faux Leather and reducing exposure when the finish dries or dulls
avoiding routine wet scrubbing on Suede/Nubuck and keeping cleaner away from vulnerable foam and glue lines
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在给自有白色运动鞋涂小苏打糊之前，[X]会辨认鞋面、鞋底、表层和胶合缝，先做隐蔽处测试，并依据干燥、磨损、染色或脱胶迹象调整刷洗、含水量和晾干方式。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With limited styling experience, [X] builds a comfortable outfit around an owned thin black bomber on a slightly cold, cloudy day, then chooses between dark boots and sneakers after accounting for possible damp ground and the chance that a delicate or pale porous upper will be hard to restore.
examples: using Leather or Faux Leather when a sturdier dark surface suits the bomber and uncertain pavement
keeping Canvas or Textile for a reliably dry day when ventilation matters more
rejecting Suede/Nubuck when the user cannot accept visible damp marks or extra care
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在微冷多云天气里，[X]虽然不熟悉穿搭，仍会围绕自有的薄黑色飞行夹克搭配舒适造型，并在深色靴子和运动鞋之间选择，兼顾可能潮湿的地面及浅色多孔鞋面难以恢复的问题。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an Italian trip, [X] compares concrete walking-shoe and sandal listings and verifies upper and sole construction, sweat management, cobblestone stability, shipping, returns, and sustainability evidence.
examples: checking composition against marketing
walking indoors before the return window closes
rejecting a slippery sole despite breathability
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利行程比较具体的步行鞋和凉鞋商品页面时，[X]会核对鞋面与鞋底构造、排汗、鹅卵石稳定性、配送、退货和可持续性证据。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After placing a toe-pinching pair in the freezer overnight with sealed water bags, [X] checks the actual upper and construction before repeating the attempt and uses any cracking, discoloration, stiffness, seam stress, or lack of stretch to choose among gentler treatment, a cobbler, and replacing shoes built on an unsuitable last.
examples: allowing only gradual controlled stretch for Leather, Suede/Nubuck, Canvas, or some Textile constructions
stopping when Faux Leather or Synthetic/Plastic creases or cracks instead of yielding
protecting Textile, Neoprene, EVA/Foam, Rubber, linings, and glued assemblies from leakage, freezing stress, or repeated distortion
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把一双夹痛脚趾的自有鞋连同密封水袋放入冰箱过夜后，[X]会在再次尝试前核对真实鞋面和结构，并用开裂、变色、变硬、缝线受力或不伸展等结果决定改用温和方法、找鞋匠，还是更换鞋楦不合脚的鞋。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a solo winter pilgrimage, [X] takes the chosen footwear system on consecutive loaded walks and records warmth, sweat, drying, grip, repairability, and developing pressure points before trusting it for the full route.
examples: testing on back-to-back wet days
changing the sock system after friction
replacing the pair before departure if drying fails
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自冬季朝圣出发前，[X]会进行连续负重步行，比较候选鞋履系统的保暖、积汗、干燥、抓地、可维修性和逐渐形成的压痛点，再决定是否用于完整路线。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When [X] and friends bring a chosen trail pair and camp pair to a managed forest site, the group compares material performance across mud, damp vegetation, sweat, fire-side drying, and repeated transitions between chores and rest.
examples: keeping the camp pair dry
cleaning mud before it hardens
noting which construction stays wet the next morning
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 当[X]和朋友们为管理规范的森林营地带上选定的徒步鞋与营地鞋时，大家会比较泥土、潮湿植被、脚汗、火边晾干，以及做杂务和休息之间反复切换时的材料表现。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After rejecting an overwhelming running-shoe guide and asking for only one or two questions at a time, [X] establishes treadmill use and an even wear pattern, then isolates whether upper ventilation, overlay durability, outsole amount, and cushioning compound fit the weekly volume and indoor heat.
examples: using engineered Textile when treadmill heat and upper breathability dominate
using EVA/Foam for a familiar cushioned daily trainer or comparing another foam only after weekly distance is known
using Rubber and Synthetic/Plastic selectively for outsole life and support rather than adding trail-grade material to an indoor shoe
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 拒绝信息过载的跑鞋购买指南、要求每次只问一两个问题后，[X]会先确认跑步机使用和鞋底均匀磨损，再单独比较鞋面通风、覆盖层耐久、外底橡胶用量和缓震材料是否符合周跑量与室内温度。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a garden wedding, [X] pairs white footwear with an already purchased brown dress but has a wide forefoot that pinches, so the try-on compares supple or stretchable uppers, dirt-sensitive finishes, adjustable construction, and grass-ready soles without treating softness as a substitute for a true wide fit.
examples: using soft Leather or a carefully chosen Faux Leather only when the upper yields without squeezing and remains cleanable outdoors
using Textile for stretch and airflow when the finish still looks appropriate for the wedding
rejecting Suede/Nubuck after weighing grass and dirt care, or selecting Rubber and EVA/Foam underfoot for stable cushioning
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加花园婚礼时，[X]要用白鞋搭配已购棕色礼服，但宽前掌会被夹；试穿会比较柔软或可伸展鞋面、易脏表层、可调结构和草地适用鞋底，同时不把柔软误当作真正宽楦。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a Tracer cosplay, [X] starts with black ankle boots and tests a removable white edge treatment on the actual surface, checking whether paint, fabric, adhesive, flexing, and light weathering will hold through walking without cracking the base or making the pair too rigid for a convention.
examples: testing flexible paint or removable fabric trim differently on Leather, Faux Leather, Suede/Nubuck, Canvas, or Textile uppers
using EVA/Foam or Synthetic/Plastic for light shaped additions only where flex and attachment remain safe
keeping Rubber tread and high-flex zones free of brittle decoration, or using a compatible flexible layer instead
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 制作 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]会以黑色踝靴作为候选底鞋，在真实表面上测试可拆卸白色边饰，检查涂料、织物、胶粘、弯折和轻度做旧能否承受步行，又不会开裂或让鞋在展会中过硬。
